title: Overture - Free Game Music Sampler - 68 Tracks from 34 Albums (OGG + MIDI)
tagline: 68 free game music tracks with loop points and MIDI, two from each of our 34 albums. Free for commercial games.

pricing.why: operator 2026-10-26: samplers are FREE; PWYW $0 with a $2 suggestion matches the live UI Kit Sampler and Blip 00 sampler records

description:
Overture is a free game music sampler: 68 tracks, two from each of our 34 game music albums, as OGG Vorbis (44.1 kHz stereo) with loop points in the file, plus the editable MIDI source of every track. 87:49 of music across fantasy and JRPG, retro console, dark and horror, folk and world, exploration, science fiction and cozy scores. Free to use in commercial and non commercial games, no attribution required. 67 of the 68 carry LOOPSTART and LOOPLENGTH, which RPG Maker MZ and MV read with no plugin; the Readme gives the same points for Godot 4, Unity and GameMaker.

Why it exists. Every album we make is one musical voice: one set of themes carried through a whole game's worth of tracks. This download lets you hear all 34 voices before you pay for any of them. From each album you get its opening piece and the last full piece it offers as a free preview, usually its boss or its climax.

Tested in two engines. All 68 files were copied into a blank RPG Maker MZ project's audio/bgm and played through MZ's own AudioManager: 68 of 68 decoded at their own length, and MZ read the loop points of all 67 looped tracks with no plugin. In a blank Godot 4.7.2 project, with Loop ticked and Loop Offset set from the Readme's table, 68 of 68 load as the Readme describes.

Nothing here is new or exclusive. Every file is byte for byte the free preview already on its album's page. The sha256 of every file is in album.json, and each was checked against its album's own free download.

What is inside. Two tracks from each album, grouped by genre:

  • Fantasy RPG and JRPG: Aetherbound Vol. I, Aetherbound Vol. II, The Long Campaign, Wayfarer, Dramatis Personae, Adversary, Ironmarch, Elven Realms, The Holy Order, Overdub Score
  • Retro console: Four Greens, Embercrown
  • Dark, gothic and horror: The Sunken Choir, Horror Manor, Spooky Season, Ashen Realm, The Run
  • Folk and world: Hearthmoot, Zarya, Longships, Frostfall, Desert, Jade Mountains, Sengoku, The Lantern Road, The Lantern Road Vol. II
  • Exploration, sea and sky: Wildwood, Saltline, The Turning Sky, Airship
  • Science fiction and synth: Nightglass, Deep Space
  • Piano, cozy and casual: The Keepsake, Bright & Cute

The 34 full albums hold 1420 tracks between them, and the Readme links every one.

Paid, from the same studio.

  • The Long Campaign ($19.99): a European high fantasy score of 50 tracks on one theme, from the title to the last boss.
  • Ashen Realm ($14.99): a dark soulslike score of 44 tracks: shrines, ruins, bosses and the quiet between them.
  • Hearthmoot ($17.99): a folk village and market score of 42 tracks: the lanes, the tavern, the market and the feast day.

Gate results. 1087 checks on these exact files, 0 failed: no clipping, loudness in range, no dead air at the start, and the loop tags read back out of the bytes. The report ships inside the download. Those numbers say the files are technically sound; they are not a claim about taste, which is what listening is for.

An honest note. The renders are a General MIDI reference render through a conventional soundfont, so the strings, brass, choirs and bells are the General MIDI sounds of those names; load the MIDI into your own instruments to replace them. The composition system is AI written code and no generative audio model is used anywhere.

Follow the studio on itch to hear about new albums when they come out.

devlog.title: Overture is out: 68 free tracks, two from each of our 34 music albums
devlog.body:
Overture is a free game music sampler: 68 tracks, two from each of our 34 albums, as OGG with loop points plus the MIDI of every track, 87:49 in all. Free for commercial games, no attribution required. It is live now at https://csaf.itch.io/free-game-music-sampler.

Why. Each of our albums is one musical voice carried through a whole game's worth of tracks. Overture lets you hear all 34 voices in one download before buying any. Every file is the same file already free on its album's page; nothing here is new or exclusive.

How it was checked. All 68 files were played by a blank RPG Maker MZ project from audio/bgm (68 of 68 at their own length, loop points read on all 67 looped tracks) and loaded by a blank Godot 4.7.2 project with the Readme's loop settings (68 of 68). 1087 audio checks, 0 failed. Those numbers say the files are technically sound, not that you will like them; that is what the download is for.

The composition system is AI written code; no generative audio model is used. The renders are General MIDI reference renders, and the MIDI is there to load into your own instruments.
